Set racing assignments in the game\'s Controls menu. Touch buttons follow those assignments. Gamepads connect automatically; X/Y axes and the D-pad navigate menus.
Choose the physical gamepad button and the key it sends. Racing touch buttons follow the assignments in the game\'s Controls menu.
Touchpad: slide anywhere to move the cursor, tap to click, hold still to grab and drag. Applies the next time the game starts.
There is no Java-visible menu/race signal yet, so auto-hide currently uses idle time in both menus and races. Touch the overlay to reveal it.
Enter a whole number from 1 to 240
IPX finds races on this Wi-Fi by itself. TCP/IP races anyone who knows the host\'s address, a PC with the original game or the Modern Patch too. Every player uses the same port.

Off: nothing is written to the log and the game starts as a player has it. On: logging and the debug options below are enabled. Launch extras (adb, the names under each switch) still win for that one start.
Racing touch buttons follow the game’s current control assignments, including gamepad buttons and axes. Menu controls use automatic defaults.
Gamepads connect automatically. Set racing buttons and axes in the game’s Controls menu. On-screen racing buttons follow those assignments.

Menus: by default, use the X/Y axes or D-pad to move, A / Cross to confirm, and B / Circle to go back. Use Gamepad test and setup to test a controller and customize directions, confirm and back. Assignments save per controller; configured directions also work in the game’s remapping screen. Touch users can tap menu items directly.

Racing: assign buttons, D-pad directions and axes in the game’s Controls menu. Axes retain proportional input; buttons remain digital. On-screen racing buttons automatically follow the current game assignments.

Split screen: connected gamepads are assigned automatically in connection order: the first to player 1 and the second to player 2. Touch racing controls operate player 1. Reconnecting pads can change their order.

The launcher does not overwrite your custom in-game bindings. Use Touch controls to change the on-screen layout, size and visibility.
